_about: Daniel Defoe's novels, histories, tracts and journalism not already on another shelf (the reading-list defoe shelf holds the rest): every English text under the name at Gutenberg that no other shelf holds. Added 2026-10-17 at the coordinator's relay of Adam's keep-going message (Adam may veto). Dates are as each title page gives them; many texts are undated.
